# casdoor_product (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor product, an item that users can buy.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_product" "pro" {
  owner        = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name         = "pro"
  display_name = "Acme Pro"
  currency     = "USD"
  price        = 19
  quantity     = 1000
  providers    = [casdoor_provider.stripe.name]
  state        = "Published"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the product, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `currency` (String) The currency, e.g. `USD`.
- `description` (String) The description.
- `detail` (String) The detail.
- `disable_custom_recharge` (Boolean) Whether users are kept from entering a custom recharge amount.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `image` (String) The image URL.
- `is_recharge` (Boolean) Whether the product recharges the balance of the user.
- `price` (Number) The price.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom properties.
- `providers` (List of String) The names of the payment providers.
- `quantity` (Number) The quantity in stock.
- `sold` (Number) The quantity sold.
- `state` (String) The state, `Published` or `Draft`.
- `success_url` (String) The URL that the user is sent to after paying.
- `tag` (String) The tag.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the product was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the product in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_product.example <organization>/<name>
```
